botcomponent.description: Sends a short notification summarising a CoE intake request that has just been created, including its identifier, business area, route, and governance category. This distributable package intentionally leaves Recipient configured as Fill with AI so it contains no tenant-specific address. Before publishing, the installer must change Recipient to Custom and select an approved target-tenant user or replace this tool with an approved channel design. Use only after a CoE triage record has been created successfully, and never on its own.
botcomponent.name: Notify the CoE triage channel
